units.source_text: 夕雾大将想道：“我已说得舌烂唇焦，至今还是毫无希望。

en.t: General Yugiri thought, "I have pleaded until my tongue and lips are worn out, yet even now there is still no hope.

units.source_text: 要她自己心许，看来是难事了。

en.t: It seems it will be difficult to make her consent of her own accord.

units.source_text: 我不妨对外人说，此婚事乃老夫人生前许下。

en.t: I might as well tell outsiders that the old lady promised this marriage while she was still alive.

units.source_text: 事出无奈，只得教死者稍任思虑疏忽之咎了。

en.t: Since there is no other way, I must let the dead bear a little blame for carelessness in judgment.

units.source_text: 不教外人知道何时开始定情，马虎过去吧。

en.t: I will keep outsiders from knowing when the attachment began and let the matter pass vaguely.

units.source_text: 现在要我回复青年时代，为恋爱流泪，向女人纠缠，似乎也不配了。”

en.t: At this point, it hardly suits me to return to my youth, shed tears for love, and cling to a woman."

units.source_text: 便计划将公主迎回一条院，正式成亲。

en.t: He therefore planned to bring the princess back to Ichijo-in and formally marry her.

units.source_text: 于是选定黄道吉日，宣召大和守前来，吩咐他应有一切事宜。

en.t: He then chose an auspicious day, summoned the Governor of Yamato, and instructed him to arrange everything necessary.
First, the palace residence was put thoroughly in order.

units.source_text: 此宫邸虽然也很华丽，但因住者皆是女子，故庭院杂草繁生。

en.t: Although the residence was quite splendid, only women lived there, so weeds had grown thickly throughout the garden.

units.source_text: 如今大加清除，并施装饰。

en.t: Now they cleared it extensively and added decorations.

units.source_text: 夕雾用心非常周到，一切务求尽善尽美。

en.t: Yugiri was extremely attentive and sought perfection in every detail.

units.source_text: 关于幔帐、屏风、帷屏、茵褥等，也都一一操心，嘱咐大和守，急速在宫邸中备办。

en.t: He also took personal care over the curtains, folding screens, standing curtains, cushions, and the like, and ordered the Governor of Yamato to prepare them quickly at the residence.
